name: California State Bar AI Ethics
caption: CA Bar
description: California-specific attorney-client confidentiality requirements per Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 6068(e)(1) and the California State Bar COPRAC Practical Guidance for the Use of Generative AI in the Practice of Law (2026). Stricter than ABA baseline: requires full anonymization (not merely tokenization) to prevent re-identification; prohibits autonomous external transmission of confidential information; treats quasi-identifiers (DOB, age, gender, location) in combination as potentially identifying. Extends aba-ethics.
frameworks: CA Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.6
CA COPRAC Practical Guidance for Generative AI (2026)
